faq.q1: Where do the prices come from?
faq.a1: From listings published by agencies and private owners, received through authorised feeds and imports. We do not collect data from portals without an agreement.
faq.q2: What is the difference between asking price and transaction price?
faq.a2: The asking price is what the advertiser wants. The transaction price is the deed value. We only show the latter when a licensed source exists, always labelled.
faq.q3: How do you know two listings are the same property?
faq.a3: We compare location, area, typology, floor, price, address and photos. With high confidence we merge the listings; with medium confidence they go to manual review.
faq.a4: Yes. Search, the map, the comparison tool and the market observatory with aggregated data are free. Pro and Agency plans add valuations, branded reports and CRM.
faq.a5: We only process the data we need, ask consent for anything non-essential, and you can export or delete your account whenever you want.

about.title: About Praça
about.intro: Praça is a real-estate intelligence portal for Portugal. It brings property search, a price observatory and professional tools together.
about.p1: We believe a property should have a single clean record, even when several agencies advertise it. And that every published number should show where it comes from.
about.p2: That is why we merge duplicates, keep the price history and state the source, date and sample of every indicator.
about.demo: This environment uses demo data generated by us. In production, properties arrive through authorised agency feeds and imports, and indicators from public open data.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.intro: How we calculate what we show. Every number has a source, a date and a sample.
methodology.medianText: Price-per-m² indicators use the median after removing the lowest 2% and highest 2% of each group. They only consider active listings of apartments and houses.
methodology.sampleText: We only publish a value for a municipality or parish with at least 10 listings. Below that, we show the next geographic level up and say so.
methodology.askingText: Prices are asking prices set by advertisers. Transaction prices are only shown when they come from a licensed source, and are always labelled.
methodology.dedupeText: We merge listings of the same property when location, typology, area, floor, price, address and photos match with high confidence. Doubtful cases go to manual review.
methodology.estimateText: It is the weighted median price per m² of similar properties (distance, typology and area), multiplied by the area. The range runs from the weighted 25th to the 75th percentile. It estimates the asking price, not a bank valuation.
methodology.yieldText: Median annual rent per m² divided by the median sale price per m² in the same territory. It does not deduct property tax, service charges or vacancy.
methodology.fiscalText: IMT, stamp duty and Euribor rates live in tables with a start-of-validity date, and each one names the official source to confirm against.

pages.legalDraft: Template document. Must be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.p1: By using Praça you accept these terms. Property information is provided by advertisers and may contain errors or be out of date.
terms.p2: Praça is not a party to deals between advertisers and interested people and does not guarantee the availability or price of properties.
terms.p3: Value estimates are indicative and do not replace a bank or expert valuation.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: We process your personal data in accordance with the GDPR. We only collect what is needed: email and name for the account, search preferences and messages you choose to send.
privacy.p2: You can access, correct, export or delete your data on the account page or by writing to us. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNPD.
privacy.p3: We keep contact messages for 24 months. Consent records are kept to prove your choice.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie policy
cookiesPage.p1: We use essential cookies (session, security, preferences) and, with your consent, statistics cookies. You can change your choice at any time.
cookiesPage.p2: Preferences are stored in your browser and consent is recorded as proof.

contacts.title: Contact
